availability_evidence: The issuer-hosted annual report states on pages 19, 59 and 88 that the Strategic Report and financial statements were approved or authorised for issue on 24 May 2019; the PDF is preserved with its hash in the source index.
observation: Kainos recorded 56% revenue growth to £151.3m, 52% adjusted pre-tax-profit growth to £23.3m, 31% higher orders and 47% higher cash with 100% cash conversion and no debt. Overall gross margin declined from 48% to 46% because contractors supported rapid growth and geographic expansion, while weaker Evolve revenue and one loss-making contract created contained product-level pressure.
already_announced_exclusion: No qualifying restructuring or equivalent intervention had been announced by cutoff; the completed reduction in Evolve product-development staffing, ordinary investment and contractor-mix decisions are excluded from the target definition.
review_note: A material gross-margin decline and contained Evolve contract pressure are outweighed by exceptional revenue, profit, orders, cash conversion and debt-free balance-sheet evidence.

availability_evidence: The issuer-hosted annual report states on pages 39, 90 and 129 that the Strategic Report and financial statements were approved or authorised for issue on 21 May 2021; the PDF is preserved with its hash in the source index.
observation: Kainos delivered its eleventh consecutive year of growth: revenue increased 31% to £234.7m, adjusted pre-tax profit increased 124% to £57.1m, bookings rose 6%, backlog rose 15% and overall gross margin expanded to 50.4% from 47.0%. Cash conversion reached 112%, net cash doubled to £80.9m and the Group had no financial-institution debt.
already_announced_exclusion: No qualifying restructuring or equivalent intervention had been announced by cutoff; pandemic operating adaptations, recruitment and ordinary growth investment are excluded from the target definition.
review_note: There is no specific unresolved company-level intervention pressure; exceptional growth, margin expansion, cash conversion, net cash and backlog supply dominant quantified contrary evidence.

availability_evidence: The issuer-hosted annual report states on pages 61, 108 and 153 that the Strategic Report and financial statements were approved or authorised for issue on 19 May 2023; the PDF is preserved with its hash in the source index.
observation: Kainos reported 24% revenue growth to £374.8m, 15% adjusted pre-tax-profit growth to £67.6m and backlog growth to £322.9m. Overall gross margin improved to 47.3% from 46.3%, although Digital Services margin slipped 60bps and higher product investment moderated profit growth. Cash conversion was 104%, cash rose to £108.3m and there was no debt.
already_announced_exclusion: No qualifying restructuring or equivalent intervention had been announced by cutoff; product investment, property-sale activity, recruitment and ordinary efficiency management are excluded from the target definition.
review_note: Minor divisional margin pressure and heavier growth investment are overwhelmed by strong revenue, profit, backlog, Group-margin, cash-conversion and debt-free balance-sheet evidence.
